description:
Goal

Represent the boxed callable seam's required return value as an ordinary typed target-demand contribution, so partial semantic demand cannot erase the carrier that a public wrapper must return.

Signal

With the RuntimeDemand unmatched-callable Whole fallback removed, 00420_enum_take_drop_split exposes an information-loss bug. Caller f228 callsite 0 invokes boxed member f191 and resumes through a public ValueRef contract. Both endpoints agree on Ty396 and Shape91. The caller's ReturnPayload/ResumePayload settles ValueRef, but f191 ExecutableReturn settles Absent. f191 receives observed return demand TupleFields([Ignore, Whole]) plus an untyped keep_return=true; derive_runtime_demand_fact applies executable-need demand only when the observed demand is absent or Ignore, so the non-bottom partial demand silently discards the wrapper obligation.

Entry identities, first-class resolution identity, ContributionMap generations, and product invalidation are correct. This is not a stale artifact, Ty-equivalence issue, or consumer layout problem.

Strategy

Publish RuntimeDemand::for_executable_need(target.need) as an exact contribution from each first-class/boxed callable seam and join it normally with the same caller's observed return demand. Prefer folding it into the existing typed return_demand contribution rather than adding a parallel flag or authority. On the pre-cutover cone, this explicit edge replaces the fixpoint-time bootstrapped/seam-members fallback; after cutover, the reactive contribution map carries and retracts it by exact caller ownership.

TDD and acceptance

- First add a focused RED with a boxed callable member whose caller observes only field 2 of a structured return. Prove the target's effective return demand is join(TupleFields([Ignore, Whole]), RuntimeDemand::for_executable_need(Value)), not merely non-Ignore.
- Prove its ExecutableReturn can materialize the ValueRef required by the caller's ReturnPayload/ResumePayload.
- A direct-only/no-box twin remains at the exact partial demand and does not gain the boundary contribution.
- Contribution replacement/retraction removes only the owning boxed seam's obligation; equal reproduction does not move the result.
- Remove the old bootstrapped set, seam-members discovery, keep_return boolean/branches, and any comments or telemetry describing that hidden fallback.
- 00420_enum_take_drop_split passes interpreter, run, and build doors without Absent/ValueRef mismatch on the RuntimeDemand cutover tree.
- Existing demand, transport-contract, retained-product, fixture, determinism, formatting, clippy, and warning-denied gates pass.
- No unmatched-callable blanket widening, Ty display strings/equivalence, consumer coercion, compatibility shim, or duplicate retained-return authority is introduced.

Documentation

Name the invariant at the producer seam: a boxed callable contributes the exact return contract of its ExecutableNeed. Update agent/user documentation only where the removed cone bootstrap or return-contribution model was described.
title: Make boxed callable return retention an exact demand contribution
